objective: Partial rollback of the previous GRU edit, to test whether that edit contributed to the user-reported stair collisions
environment_contract: Hexapod-Stair-Student-A: 271 observations, GRU256, ELU MLP256/128, 18 actions, policy50Hz
environment_provenance_limit: Architecture matches the current source; checkpoint has no training-run metadata to prove its exact training commit

patch.operation: subtract log(candidate_odds) from update-gate input bias
patch.interpretation: At identical x,h, (1-z)/z is multiplied by candidate_odds; this is not a gait speed multiplier

optimizer_note: Retained verbatim for checkpoint compatibility; no optimizer step was taken. This is an inference experiment. Further distillation toward the unchanged teacher can undo the edit.

checks.kind: synthetic network checks, not simulation or locomotion evaluation

limitations: No Isaac Lab/Newton runtime was available locally; no physical rollout was run.
The policy needs memory to infer its phase; reduced retention may worsen phase tracking, stability or ascent speed.
Synthetic finite outputs do not demonstrate robot stability, success rate or faster climbing.
No best candidate has been selected from simulation results.
If the original checkpoint already has the same collisions, partial rollback is not a targeted repair of that underlying behavior.

required_comparison.controls: Identical environment version, robot asset, seeds, initial poses, action clipping and normalization; deterministic inference; reset GRU between episodes
required_comparison.initial_state: Use phase 0 only for full-ascent timing: stair_reset buffer_ratio=0, x_ranges=((-0.1,0.1),)
metrics: stair-face collisions and contacted body part
required_comparison.selection: Compare identical resets and seeds. Accept only after observing fewer collisions and no meaningful loss of success rate; also record total ascent time and timeouts. No improvement has yet been measured.

user_feedback.comparison_with_original: same collision also occurs in original model_2650.pt
user_feedback.first_wsp_result: transition delay reduced and stair ascent appears faster

revision.interpretation: Reduces the previous update-gate logit edit to approximately 31%. This is not a speed percentage, collision detector or clearance correction. Causality has not been established.
revision.assessment_after_user_feedback: Partial rollback does not target the reported pre-existing knee collision; no longer the preferred collision-repair direction.

current_diagnostic_direction: Preserve first WSP as the faster candidate. Diagnose knee/riser clearance and contact before choosing another weight edit; no collision correction validated.
